annotations.text:
StorageBill Pro — dashboard ke 3 alag direction. Sab sample data hai.
Har ek ke upar 'accent' chip se colour badal kar dekh sakte ho.
Ek chuniye, ya do ko milane ko boliye.

A — Dark, numbers-first. Paisa sabse upar, bottom nav, + button.
Kiske liye: jo roz ka hisaab ek nazar mein chahta hai.
Tradeoff: dhoop mein / bright godown mein dark screen bhaari lag sakti hai.

B — Light, kaam-first. Screen khud ek to-do list hai: har card par ek button.
Kiske liye: jo phone kholte hi jaanna chahta hai 'aaj kya karna hai'.
Tradeoff: dashboard jaisa kam lagta hai; numbers chhote hain.

C — Colourful, visual. Godown ke slots ka nakshaa, rang-birange tiles, bade icon.
Kiske liye: jo app 'dikhne' mein alag chahta hai aur staff ko bhi chalana ho.
Tradeoff: rang zyada hai — restraint na rakha to khilona lagega.
